description: This file defines the internal sealed class SharedCallbackData, which encapsulates data and behavior related to callback handling, including response timeouts, logging, and cancellation management for grain calls in Orleans runtime.

classes.name: SharedCallbackData
classes.description: Encapsulates callback data including timeout management, logging, and cancellation for Orleans grain calls.

methods.name: SharedCallbackData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize SharedCallbackData with callback, logger, response timeout, cancellation behavior flags, and cancellation manager.

methods.name: ResponseTimeout
methods.description: Property to get or set the response timeout duration, updating the timeout stopwatch ticks accordingly.
